title: Digital Twin La Reina - Original Procedural PBR Materials
authoring: Deterministic NumPy/Pillow procedural synthesis; seed161026; no third-party bitmap inputs or external asset dependencies.
rights: Original textures created for this project; dedicated to CC0 1.0 by the authoring agent to the extent legally possible. No third-party attribution required.
source_reference: Visual matching only: team proposal renders in propuestaEspacialMLR/Imagenes. No pixels copied.
packing: Unity Standard / URP Lit Metallic workflow: Metallic R, Smoothness A. G/B zero, unused. RGBA alpha is roughness inverse, NOT transparency.

Floor_DarkTile.normal_import: Unity Texture Type Normal map; do not mark Create from Grayscale
Floor_DarkTile.tiling_formula: renderer physical U,V span in metres divided by physical_repeat_metres
Floor_DarkTile.description: Original dark gray staggered rectangular tile; each tile0.80x0.40m, approx3mm joint. Use floor UV in metres or tiling5x11.25 for an8x9m flat quad aligned with1.6x0.8m repeat.

Steel_DarkBrushed.normal_import: Unity Texture Type Normal map; do not mark Create from Grayscale
Steel_DarkBrushed.tiling_formula: renderer physical U,V span in metres divided by physical_repeat_metres
Steel_DarkBrushed.description: Original blackened brushed steel with restrained horizontal hairline grain. Floor/table pedestal/ceiling metal. MetallicR0.90; smoothness about0.57.

Cladding_Perforated.normal_import: Unity Texture Type Normal map; do not mark Create from Grayscale
Cladding_Perforated.tiling_formula: renderer physical U,V span in metres divided by physical_repeat_metres
Cladding_Perforated.description: Original perforated-metal appearance for columns:5mm staggered pitch,2.5mm visual diameter. Holes are opaque shaded recesses for real-time performance, not physical through-holes.

Fabric_Charcoal.normal_import: Unity Texture Type Normal map; do not mark Create from Grayscale
Fabric_Charcoal.tiling_formula: renderer physical U,V span in metres divided by physical_repeat_metres
Fabric_Charcoal.description: Original charcoal woven upholstery for chair cushions/back/arms.4cm repeat,0.5mm yarn pitch. Use UV at physical scale; reduce normal multiplier to0.4 if camera aliasing.

revision_0_2: Walls and ceiling cladding use plain materials without procedural cladding texture. Floor, chair fabric and steel retain procedural maps. Cladding_Perforated files are kept as prior iteration assets, unused in current scene.
